title: Xiao Hui's third eye and the Soul Revival ritual
summary: In the Mystic Fire Altar, Xiao Hui's third eye opens and it shows itself as a Three-Eyed Spirit Monkey while Gui Li fights the Crimson Flame Beast, which keeps reforming as long as the formation is active. The formation's evil makes the Soul-Devouring Stick harder to control, and Gui Li is flooded by memories of Pu Zhi and of his years on Great Bamboo Peak. At the gate, Shangguan Ce studies the dead fish-men, wonders how such thick-skinned fighters died, and decides the mastermind behind them matters more than they do. He posts red-eyed eagles at every exit, warns that the killer may be disguised among the disciples, and orders Lu Shun to check the Golden Bell Formation and Li Xun to check the disciples, privately fearing a plan centuries in the making is unravelling. Deep in the altar Gui Li finds a cold stone altar carved with ritual images not made by people of the Central Plains, showing Soul Revival Magic, and guesses the Mystic Fire Mirror is the key. A voice in the dark tells him he is not Shangguan Ce, recognises his weapon as made of the Sinister Bead and the Soul-Eating Stick, and warns that its evil has entered his body and will drive him mad.
